model_interpretation.claim: Mapping threadIdx.x to output columns while keeping the serial K loop and 32-by-32 CTA output shape should give each warp contiguous B and C accesses (and a broadcast A access), isolating the baseline lane-mapping cost before adding shared-memory tiling. This is a hypothesis; the controller must measure it.

items.subject: Coalescing control plus synchronous SIMT CTA tiling
items.objective: First benchmark a minimal coalesced, row-major one-output-per-thread kernel with lanes varying over columns, to isolate the cost of the supplied baseline’s lane mapping. Then explore synchronous shared-memory CTA tiles using that coalesced orientation and one output per thread, varying tile dimensions and K depth. Support tails and all valid dimensions and values, compute every output with the requested alpha/beta semantics, and report correctness and repeated timing. Use full-FP32 CUDA-core arithmetic only; preserve the entry point and buffer/stream constraints, with no extra allocations or external math libraries.
